verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a built-in memory system that lets models remember facts, preferences, and context across conversations, which supports durable cross-session recall. However, the only documented way to write memories is manual: users add, edit, or delete them under Settings > Personalization > Memory. Nothing in the pack shows the assistant writing memories on its own, so the story is only half delivered. missing for 10: documented automatic memory writing by the assistant, detail on how and when recall is injected into chats, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically

citations.quote: Open WebUI includes a sophisticated memory system that allows models to remember facts, preferences, and context across different conversations.
The AI remembers facts about you across conversations
Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory
